detailed_goals: Input and validate 100% of collected electronic health records (EHRs) from the first week's data collection into the hospital's EHR system.
Ensure all patient data entries are complete, accurate, and compliant with HIPAA standards.
Coordinate with the EHR Specialist to resolve any data discrepancies or missing information.
Generate a weekly report summarizing data entry progress and identifying any recurring data quality issues.
Clean and preprocess the EHR data collected in Week 1 to ensure data integrity and consistency.
Develop a preliminary data model for influenza trend analysis, including patient demographics and symptom data.
Begin analyzing the first set of influenza-related cases using statistical methods to identify early patterns.
Create a draft report summarizing initial findings and present it to the team for feedback.
Finalize the EHR data collection protocol and ensure all data entry workflows are standardized.
Conduct a system audit to verify data security and access controls for EHRs.
Collaborate with the IT Support Technician to resolve any system access or integration issues.
Provide training to the Clinical Data Entry Clerk on EHR data validation best practices.
Review the initial influenza case data collected and identify potential clusters or trends.
Coordinate with the Data Analyst to align influenza surveillance criteria with the analysis framework.
Begin drafting a surveillance report template for weekly influenza trend updates.
Initiate communication with local public health authorities to share preliminary findings.
Ensure the EHR system and data analysis tools are fully operational and accessible to all team members.
Implement backup and disaster recovery protocols for EHR and influenza data storage.
Provide technical support for data entry and analysis tools, resolving any connectivity or software issues.
Conduct a security audit of the hospital's network to ensure compliance with data protection standards.
